# SOP-P2-L1-05 Planned shutdown - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01, EQ-P2-L1-IH02, EQ-P2-L1-SB03

Preconditions
1. Verify maintenance window approval is recorded per QS-PROC-06 and ECN-2026-033.
2. Notify operations and safety leads; ensure line is controlled and energy isolated per lockout procedures in SB-1030.
3. Confirm all billets removed from process and inventories staged clear of work area.

PPE
1. Safety glasses.
2. Cut-resistant gloves.
3. Hearing protection.
4. Flame-resistant clothing.
5. Arc face protection when electrical panels open.

Shutdown Steps
1. Isolate main supply to Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) and confirm zero energy per SB-1030.
2. Isolate induction power to Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) and verify control circuit de-energized.
3. Drain residual process hydraulic lines on EQ-P2-L1-RR01 and EQ-P2-L1-SB03 per QS-PROC-06.
4. Secure mechanical restraints on movable tooling; verify mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m before unbolting fixtures.
5. Tag and lockout all feed and control panels following SB-1030 tagging procedures.
6. Verify coil cooling water flow to Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) meets minimum specification: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 55 L/min. Record flow confirmation on the shutdown checklist.
7. Remove guarding only after panels are isolated; perform required inspections and repairs.
8. Re-energize only after completion of work, clearance from safety lead, and checklist verification per QS-PROC-06 and ECN-2026-033.

Post-shutdown Verification
1. Confirm all tools and loose items cleared.
2. Restore guards and perform function test in local mode prior to production restart.

Sign-off
1. Maintenance lead: __________________
2. Safety officer: __________________
3. Production supervisor: __________________

References
- ECN-2026-033
- QS-PROC-06
- SB-1030
